brief.tc: 目前有五個地區的水供應中斷，包括中西區、九龍城區、元朗區、北區和南區。醫院的等待時間方面，廣華醫院的最長等待時間為7.5小時，基督教聯合醫院為6.5小時，天水圍醫院為5.5小時。空氣質素指數為中等，最大風速為每小時30公里。現時有120個泊位，其中27個空置。
brief.en: Currently, there are five districts with water supply suspension: Central and Western District, Kowloon City District, Yuen Long District, North District, and Southern District. In terms of hospital waiting times, the longest wait at Kwong Wah Hospital is 7.5 hours, 6.5 hours at Christian Alliance Hospital, and 5.5 hours at Tin Shui Wai Hospital. The air quality index is moderate, with a maximum wind speed of 30 km/h. There are 120 berths, with 27 vacant.
